findings.says: With @magicui added, a search that names no registry covers only @magicui and does not say it skipped @shadcn, though get_project_registries lists both. This breaks "The registries get_project_registries lists are the ones a search covers when no registry is named."

evidence.saw: get_project_registries: "- @shadcn - @magicui"; search {query: accordion}: "Found 7 items matching \"accordion\" in registries @magicui"
